name: web

scripts.test: ng test hub && ng test runner && ng test fleet
scripts.build: npm run build:hub && npm run build:runner
scripts.story-render: tsc --noEmit -p projects/fleet/.storybook/tsconfig.json && npm run storybook:build && node scripts/story-render-check.js

//: vite is a direct devDependency because @storybook/angular-vite needs Vite 8 as a peer while @angular/build keeps its own Vite 7.3.6 nested beneath it, so ng build and ng serve build as before and only the unit-test builder and the workshop run on the hoisted Vite 8. npm's resolver cannot add this set under strict peer checking, because it walks optional peers (analog -> @angular-devkit/build-angular -> @angular/localize -> exact @angular/compiler-cli 21.2.25), so the next change to it must resolve the lock once with --legacy-peer-deps, never commit that setting, and re-prove that a strict npm install leaves package-lock.json unchanged and a strict npm ci passes. The one npm ci ERESOLVE warning is expected: @vitejs/plugin-basic-ssl, under @angular/build, peers vite ^6 || ^7 and sees the hoisted 8, which only ng serve --ssl loads.
